cockpit.note: Mockup-informed dark field: deep navy gradient, node-core dots, arrowed teal flux, square status chips and square cards. Cross-unit orders diagonals now carry stable source-scope tints so they stay traceable through intervening scopes; within-unit causal ribbons keep the single causal color. No blur or blend-mode compositing.

node-detail.note: Detail rung over wide cyan flux ribbons and a soft field; inner chips stay legible. The focus lens sits in free canvas space below its source card. Cross-unit causal filaments are tinted by source scope while the relation is preserved.

deep-focus.note: Opt-in focus scale and dimmed context still read cleanly over the flux field. Lens stays anchored and bounded; the large focused card keeps its square language.

fractal.note: Inner chips now read as graph nodes: boundary-anchored directed spokes, start/end ports and failed/error status color. Same bounded depth <= 2 tree; no renderer branch.

recursion.note: Depth-3 bounded recursion with the INNER tab and radial graph layout. Inner chips reveal their full names on hover or keyboard focus; the settled and intermediate frames still pass vision gates.

fit-wide-far.note: Far octave (fit x 0.5), wide canvas. Core LOD hides card interiors at the scale floor; the frame reads as topology. Vision gate passes.

fit-wide-mid.note: Ergonomic target octave on the wide canvas: cards and labels fit inside aspect-derived insets.

fit-wide-near.note: Near octave (fit x 2) on the wide canvas; detail rung stays legible.

fit-narrow-far.note: Far octave on the 900x1000 canvas; topology-only by core LOD, gate passes.

fit-narrow-mid.note: Narrow-canvas target octave at 900px: the command bar stays on one row, so the canvas starts at y=62 instead of y=112. Lateral insets are halved and primary labels keep a reserved lane.

fit-narrow-near.note: Near octave on the narrow canvas: one-row command bar, no overlap regression and no truncated primary labels.

dense-type.note: Opt-in preset (ladder.minLabelPx 18): tighter card padding, one-step larger body/meta rows and shorter card height. The label lane reserves glyph width and padding, so raised labels do not truncate. Vision gates pass across all six fit cells; not a default (ADR 0008).

living-graph.note: Motion L1/L3 opt-in preset: one-shot active-card pulse and longer rung/camera clocks. Comparison evidence in motion/; reduced motion reaches the same settled state. Not a default (ADR 0008).

dynamic-range.note: Scale floor on starfield: card interiors yield to topology by core LOD, and ring artifacts merge with the field. Flux filaments remain distinguishable at low zoom.

layout-stacked.note: Transcript below the graph leaves the flux field intact; readout stays inside the canvas and the panel does not clip node cards.

layout-floating.note: Collapsed floating transcript gives the graph the full canvas; compact scope rows stay readable with the wider field.

neon-cockpit.note: Emissive palette over the dark gradient field; additive edge halos are subtle and cards remain square and legible.

aurora-map.note: Map surface keeps the flux filaments legible at full scope; rings replace solid artifact balls.

light-theme.note: Field uses reduced opacity instead of a blend mode in light theme; the canvas HUD now uses a light grayscale token, giving 17.7:1 contrast over the dark canvas. Cards, halos and flux edges keep contrast.

catalog.note: Proof catalog lists every preset and question without claiming a winner; drawer overlay does not hide the flux graph. Each summary is a 44px square bordered row after AUDIT-02.

ui-scale-aware.note: Opt-in scale-aware packing experiment; no shipped default changed. Incumbent/variant pair: docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/scale-aware/{incumbent,variant}.png. Offline coverage comparison: docs/screenshots/reports/presence-scale-aware.json. Human verdict pending in docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/comparison.json (ui-preset-scale-aware).

ui-continuity.note: Phase 3 traceability shot for the opt-in continuous grammar: square collars, tapered core, one-sided sheath, salience-driven bend and one causal accent on border, port, transcript dot and focus ring; grid recedes through theme.backdrop=flat. No shipped default changed. Incumbent/variant pair: docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/continuity/{incumbent,variant}.png. Human verdict pending in docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/comparison.json (ui-preset-continuity).

ui-readable.note: Phase 4 traceability shot for the opt-in readable chrome: 13px body and 12px secondary, plain-language labels with jargon in tooltips, and a 300px on-demand rail behind a four-panel strip. The graph, renderer labels and shipped defaults are unchanged. Incumbent/variant pair: docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/readable/{incumbent,variant}.png. Human verdict pending in docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/comparison.json (ui-preset-readable).

ergonomic.note: Opt-in consumer of the general ergonomic heuristic: column count follows the surface aspect, nodes are ordered and swap-refined for short edges, and the grid is packed to a measured occupancy target. The solver is host-agnostic and lives in src/layout/ergonomics.ts; no Pi-specific rule and no default changed. Incumbent: docs/screenshots/pi/pi-agent-in-action.png; variant: docs/screenshots/pi/pi-agent-ergonomic.png.

chapters.note: Opt-in chapters experiment: one card per turn (plus Run), with each turn's work rendered as internal chips and the failure chip tinted by severity. No separate turn lane/card duplication, short inter-chapter edges and a compact two-column grid. Freeform, timeline and every other view stay reachable; no default flipped. Incumbent: pi/pi-agent-in-action.png / pi/pi-agent-timeline-rows.png; variant: docs/screenshots/pi/pi-agent-chapters.png. Human verdict pending in docs/screenshots/reports/graph-layout-comparison.json (chapters-subgraphs).

octaves.note: Opt-in multi-octave dynamic range (?graphLayout=octaves): root, children and grandchildren are drawn at 1x, 1/2x and 1/4x world scale in one frame, so self-similar structure is visible at fit zoom. Generic helper src/layout/octaves.ts; one position authority; no renderer branch or default flip. Pair: pi/pi-agent-dynamic-range.png / pi/pi-agent-octaves.png. Human verdict pending in docs/screenshots/reports/graph-layout-comparison.json (multi-octave-range).

octaves-palette.note: Opt-in per-octave card colour (?shot=octaves-palette or ?graphLayout=octaves&octavePalette=1): root, branches and work cards use three step colours through the existing data.style.backgroundColor seam. Positions, sizes, edges and renderer are unchanged; this is the scale-lab winner ported to Pi as one named shot. Pair: pi/pi-agent-octaves.png / pi/pi-agent-octaves-palette.png. Human verdict pending in docs/screenshots/reports/graph-layout-comparison.json (octave-palette).

octaves-near.note: Zoom evidence for the multi-octave experiment: framing one second-octave branch promotes its quarter-scale work cards to legible size without changing the layout or renderer. Regenerable with pnpm --filter pi shot octaves-near.

scenario-workflow-chapters.note: Two-domain proof pair: the second host applies the generic chapter grid to the workflow domain through one position source, with no renderer branch or host vocabulary in the library. Incumbent/variant pair: docs/screenshots/labs/scenario-workflow-chapters/{incumbent,variant}.png. Human verdict pending in docs/screenshots/reports/scenario-comparison.json.

ui-menus.note: Opt-in chrome experiment (?ui=menus): the existing command-bar controls stay mounted under their original ids and move into a toggled overlay. No shipped default changed. Incumbent/variant pair: docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/menus/{incumbent,variant}.png. Human verdict pending in docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/comparison.json (ui-preset-menus).

ui-statusline.note: Opt-in status strip (?ui=statusline): attention keeps its text and attributes, with sibling event, counters and view sections. No shipped default changed. Incumbent/variant pair: docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/statusline/{incumbent,variant}.png. Human verdict pending in docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/comparison.json (ui-preset-statusline).

chapters-wide.note: Opt-in viewport-derived chapter columns (?graphLayout=chapters&graphColumns=4) on a 2400x1000 canvas. The library default stays two columns; no renderer branch or contract field. Pair: pi/pi-agent-chapters.png / pi/pi-agent-chapters-wide.png. Human verdict pending in docs/screenshots/reports/graph-layout-comparison.json (chapters-wide).

ui-field-targets.note: Traceability shot for the opt-in solved-target scope fields: frames come from the solver's world bounds through a general renderer projection seam, not from animated node screen positions. The incumbent path is unchanged and no default flipped. Incumbent/variant pair: docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/field-targets/{incumbent,variant}.png. Human verdict pending in docs/screenshots/labs/ui-presets/comparison.json (ui-preset-field-targets).

policy.note: Live policy panel shows provenance badges by family; quiet preset values remain distinguishable in the narrower canvas. Primary labels keep their reserved lane after AUDIT-03.
